name: Hermite Data Generation from Voxel Grid
definition: A technique to generate Hermite data (position and normal) for surface intersections within a voxel grid by iterating over active cells, determining the Marching Cubes configuration via density thresholds, and sampling intersections along specified edges.
summary: Hermite Data Generation from Voxel Grid decouples Marching Cubes edge intersection calculation from mesh triangulation to store geometric primitives for downstream processing.
